basis: Benign neoplasm arising in the parathyroid endocrine gland; skeletal and renal complications are not intrinsic to this tumour concept.
Reactive endothelial proliferation within blood vessels; associated local thrombus does not establish a systemic coagulation disorder.
MAF-related nonsyndromic cataract; associated abnormalities remain within the ocular axis.
Hyperplasia of thyroid parafollicular endocrine cells; associated endocrine syndromes are separate conditions.
Inherited skeletal muscle dystrophy; aspiration pneumonia in one reported patient is a separately diagnosed complication, not established common intrinsic lung disease.
Developmental brain, skeletal and cardiac abnormalities define the syndrome; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Skeletal asymmetry and scoliosis are variable.
Wilms tumour arising in the kidney; stromal predominance does not imply a separate musculoskeletal site.
Y-chromosome structural anomaly chiefly affecting sexual development and fertility; endocrine dysfunction or other axis damage is not established across this umbrella.
Microcephaly and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism define the syndrome; short stature and facial dysmorphism alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Chronic immune-mediated demyelinating disease of peripheral nerves; weakness reflects neuropathy rather than intrinsic skeletal muscle disease.
Task-specific focal dystonia is a neurologic movement disorder; muscle contraction does not establish intrinsic muscle damage.
Carcinoma arising in anal canal mucosa; distant organ tumours and skin ulceration occur in 5-29%. HPV association does not make the carcinoma an infection.
Developmental defect of the superior eyelid; associated syndromic anomalies are not intrinsic to isolated eyelid coloboma.
Benign tumour confined to breast ducts; breast has no axis.
Diaphragm defect; lung hypoplasia 2/2, respiratory failure 2/3, pulmonary hypertension 2/2 and malrotation 2/2. Singleton neurologic findings omitted under cap and uncertain prevalence.
Unstable angina is defined by coronary myocardial ischaemia; no additional organ involvement is intrinsic.
Inherited ossifying fibroma is a bone lesion. Dental displacement and impaction are reported, but their frequency and functional impact are unspecified.
Lysosomal storage disorder; intellectual disability and scoliosis 80-99%; gingival overgrowth 80-99% and dental disease 30-79%. Hepatomegaly and chronic otitis only 5-29%.
Atrophy of the cerebellum and inferior olivary structures localizes the disease to the central nervous system.
Progressive CNS disease, deafness and anemia define it; renal tubular acidosis in 1/2 patients. Dermatitis 30-79% and metabolic acidosis omitted under the four-axis cap.
Fetal akinesia deformation with defining brain malformations and musculoskeletal contractures; eyelid dysmorphism lacks established functional ocular involvement.
Structural defect of the iris; confined to the ocular axis.
Pyrimidine catabolism defect; intellectual disability 10/22 and seizures/developmental delay 30-79%. Drug toxicity excluded; skeletal parentage conflicts with the definition.
Defined by disease of hormone-secreting neuroendocrine glands; nervous-system injury is not established across this broad group.
Childhood CNS calcification disorder; the explicit Aicardi-Goutieres parent supports an innate immune disease mechanism. No additional common organ damage is documented.
